limitations: Bounded affine homogeneous lowest-order HCurl cube, 5326 DOF / 3937 tetrahedra; not high-order/curved/general-material acceptance.
Two ABBA cycles, 4 contexts per variant; nonlinear/linear whole-API times include transfers and output recovery, exclude MATLAB/GPU initialization, fixture loading and result serialization.
Linear reuse fixes geometry, labels, reluctivity and gauge mass and scales only the current source. Nonlinear solve retains adaptive rebuilding; nonlinear mesh/session reuse is not newly implemented.
Regular PCG iteration host synchronizations reduced from two to one; initial/final and convergence-triggered true residual checks remain.
Coarse action caching and device curvature were measured together; no isolated attribution to one optimization.

Previous max_phase_owned_bytes_upper_bound is not a total bound and excludes new coarse caches; separately reported cache/workspace bytes and endpoint/50ms process samples do not certify transient global device/host peaks.
Candidate kernel tested on A100 is the same hash as the 100-built artifact. Unchanged private DLL payload was hash verified; this run did not repeat the historical live DLL-module audit.
No installed/common-release wheel replacement; radia-gpu owner integration and release acceptance are separate.
